race.comment: Tough race to finish. RUSSIAN FRONT (6) is racing consistently, beaten 1.5 lengths into fourth at Geelong last time out in a BM62. He doesn't win many but should be right there again coming back a notch or two in grade. RANAKYE (4) won well two back in a 0-56, good again latest at Mornington. Backs up quickly and should take some catching once more. LULU DARLING (14) is a 9yo mare who hasn't won in a while, ridden out of her pattern last time at Corowa. Form prior was sound and she's raced well here. LEGACY BEL (8) is going okay, fourth at Sale in a BM62 last time out is good form for this and she draws for a soft run, consider.
